top_findings.title: language factor is typescript but the deliverable is plain CommonJS JavaScript
top_findings.evidence: stack.json language="typescript"; the only source files are server.js and test.js (CommonJS require/module.exports, server.js:1-3, server.js:201); package-lock.json has no node_modules/typescript entry and package.json declares no typescript/ts-jest/@types dependency; TASK.md 'Technical constraints' says 'Use the specified language and framework'. Sibling cells of the same task did emit .ts (e.g. ..._stack=q4/rep4/src/server.ts). The idiomatic scorer returned 0.0 in scores.json.
top_findings.suggestion: Author server.ts/test.ts with a tsconfig.json and ts-jest (or compile with tsc), so the run actually exercises the typescript level of the language factor.
